_meta.notes: Owned by O01. Environments, ports and health thresholds.

environments.notes: Environment separation. Selected by NODE_ENV; never inferred from the hostname.

cors_origins.notes: Browser origins allowed to call the API. Overridden by CORS_ORIGINS (comma-separated).

dev_allowed_environments.notes: Environments where the dev panel and /dev endpoints may exist at all. Remove 'local' to require an admin account even on your own machine.

dev_admin_accounts.notes: Account ids allowed to use dev tools outside a local run. The admin role also qualifies; an anonymous connection never does.

metrics_path.notes: Serves the tick timing window (active/near/dormant ms, budget warnings). Set to an empty string to disable the route.

metrics_window_ticks.notes: Ticks of history the tick metrics keep before overwriting: 300 is 15 s at 20 Hz.

trust_proxy.notes: Trust X-Forwarded-For for the client IP. Enable only behind a proxy that overwrites the header (e.g. the staging tunnel); otherwise rate limits can be spoofed.

readiness_requires_db.notes: When true, /ready returns 503 unless Postgres answers.

db_idle_timeout_ms.notes: How long an idle Postgres client stays in the pool before closing.
